one_line_contribution: A pre-registered ALFWorld measurement of what fraction of a procedural memory bank's task-type-specific advantage is already held by a GEPA instruction optimized on the identical episodes, identified by crossing instruction provenance with bank provenance over a fetch-and-place vs appliance-operate split of the six task types, and reported as a scale-free absorbed share A = 1 - Inner(I_own)/Inner(I_oth) with a co-primary neutral-denominator twin A0.
closest_prior_work: AutoManual (arXiv 2405.16247) is the most dangerous, and the proposal concedes it only after a reviewer supplied it: it builds rules from ALFWorld interaction and compiles them into a single markdown manual that replaces per-episode experience lookup, in this exact environment. Together with AutoGuide (2403.08978) it already establishes both halves of the framing - episodic experience can be rewritten as instruction text, and a compiled manual competes with retrieval - so the title question 'is your agent's memory just an un-optimized prompt' is a 2024 question, and prediction 6 (row 11, compile-once) is a replication with token matching, as the proposal admits. ExpeL (2308.10144) removes the architectural distinction entirely by storing its memory as a prepended natural-language insights block, and EvoAgentBench (2607.05202) supplies the qualitative headline on shared trajectories. What survives is genuinely narrower than the title: labelling both containers by episode provenance, running the crossover, and putting a CI on the resulting ratio. That is identification-and-quantification on top of an accepted qualitative result, which is what the proposal itself says its worth is capped at.
strongest_objection: The confirmatory bar is explicitly A and A0 and 'nothing else', yet the rival that best explains a large A is left unthresholded and one gate biases the estimate. (a) Generic compression: if I_own is simply a better-specified instruction, a well-specified policy is less steerable by any injected block, so Inner(I_own) shrinks toward zero with zero content transfer. The proposal's answer is the multiplicative headroom floor A_h = 0.06-0.12 - which it concedes is 'a model, not a law' - plus Ladder T, and Ladder T's A_epi is explicitly demoted to descriptive because SE(A_epi) is approximately 0.30. So the single number the paper is named for has no thresholded control against its own leading alternative. Worse, a generic loss of prompt-steerability shrinks help(I_own) and |off(I_own)| together, which lands in Rule M's 'otherwise mixed' bucket and therefore blocks nothing. (b) Rule M contradicts the bar: 'absorption is claimed only if the help term carries >= 2/3 of Delta-Inner' cannot coexist with 'Both must pass; nothing else gates the confirmatory claim.' One of those sentences has to go, and which one goes changes the paper. (c) Selection on the denominator: G6 requires Inner(I_oth) >= 5pt and Inner(I0*) >= 5pt 'on S_test', the same 1,200 games from which A and A0 are computed. A ratio conditioned on its own denominator exceeding a floor measured in the same sample is biased upward exactly in the hypothesis's direction, and the 90% one-sided bootstrap lower bound does not have nominal coverage under that rule. G3 is correctly on S_dev2; G6 is not, and nothing in Measurement and Noise Control addresses the conditioning. (d) The modal outcome is a branch, not the endpoint: G3 demands a 9pt type-specific advantage, which by the proposal's own algebra requires off(I0*) <= -4pt, i.e. that a bank built from pick_and_place / pick_two / look_in_light actively harms on clean / cool / heat games by four points, even though all six types share navigation, goto, take, open and put and the off-type bank still teaches all of it. The proposal calls G3 'deliberately a coin flip'; a reviewer will read that as roughly even odds that 990,000 calls buy a type-generic finding instead of the paper.
what_would_fix_it: 1) Promote I_type - the hand-written instruction given only the three type names and their canonical skeleton, zero episodes - to Tier 0 and treat it as a third level reference. At approximately 25,500 calls it is 2.5% of the budget and it is now the only cheap arm that separates 'absorbed these episodes' from 'knows which three task types are coming', because A_epi has been demoted and row 17's B'_own answers the bank-side question, not the instruction-side one (the proposal concedes exactly this in risk 26). Pay for it by cutting row 12 (J) to one seed or dropping the 25% arm of row 9. 2) Move G6's denominator floor off S_test onto S_dev2, as G3 already is, or reserve an independent slice for it, and report by simulation how much the conditioning inflates A under the pre-registered rule. 3) Decide Rule M's status in writing: either fold the >= 2/3 help-share into the intersection-union rule alongside A and A0, or stop saying absorption is 'claimed only if' it holds. 4) Fund row 4 at row-2 scale (or drop A_all, M_shuf, or one J seed to pay for it) so the study's central rival explanation has a thresholded test rather than a CI that is twice too wide. 5) Report absorption of the total bank gain g(I, B_own) - g(I, M0) as a co-reported endpoint, not only the type-specific Inner: the title, the abstract's rhetoric and the practical recommendation are all about the former, while the confirmatory number is about a restricted slice. 6) Run pre-freeze obligations (1) and (2) before submission rather than before the freeze - as written, novelty is conditional on searches that have never been executed.
missing_baseline: I_type at Tier 0 - a hand-written instruction given only the three task-type names and their canonical skeleton, no episodes. It is currently Tier 1 and refused with the reason that 'its decisive role was interpreting a branch that is no longer a decision rule', but that reasoning inverted once A_epi stopped being thresholded: without it, an A of 0.7 is equally consistent with 'the optimizer absorbed these 300 episodes' and 'any text naming the three upcoming task types kills the on-type bank's edge', and the paper cannot tell a reviewer which. Second omission a reviewer will demand: the raw long-context trajectory dump (R_raw / M_all) read at I_own, also Tier 1. EvoMemBench-style results that long-context baselines stay competitive against 15 memory methods are cited in the proposal's own Related Work, so a reviewer will ask why the cheapest rival container - just paste the episodes - never appears in the confirmatory grid while a distractor control, a shuffled-bank control and three denominators do.
preprint_collision: The check is unusually disciplined in form - dated scans (2026-09-03, prior 2026-08-21), named verification channels, an explicit statement that arXiv is unreachable from the node, and up-front concession of EvoAgentBench (2607.05202) and ExpeL (2308.10144) rather than burial - and I can name no preprint that makes this exact absorbed-share claim. But the check does not establish novelty, and the proposal says so itself. First, the one search that would establish the novelty actually claimed - held-out-episode and data-provenance crossovers in the prompt-optimization, contamination and data-attribution literatures - is pre-freeze obligation (1) and its status is stated as UNRUN and freeze-blocking. An unrun search behind the load-bearing claim is a weakness, not a neutral. Second, obligation (2), the appendix of arXiv 2608.14036, is named by the authors as the live collision that would gut prediction 6 and is unopened. Third, the scan's recall is demonstrably poor exactly where this framing originates: it missed AutoManual (2405.16247, NeurIPS 2024) and AutoGuide (2403.08978), both pre-2026, both in ALFWorld, both rewriting episodic experience as instruction text, and both had to be supplied by a reviewer. A scan weighted to the last six months cannot certify novelty for an idea whose ancestors are from 2023-2024, and the promised pre-2026 re-sweep is also unrun. Fourth, verification depth: only EvoAgentBench was read from a PDF, and that PDF was PI-supplied; every other 2026 ID rests on a single web-snippet channel, and the load-bearing 'confirmed absent from the paper' claims for competitors are asserted from abstracts. My own knowledge does not extend past mid-2026, so I can verify neither the existence nor the content of the majority of the cited IDs, which means the claim that no combined optimizer-plus-memory provenance manipulation exists anywhere is currently unfalsified rather than checked.
